command:
set -e; SERIAL=RFCT70L7E8J; state(){ adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry 2>/dev/null | sed -n 's/.*mCallState=\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -n1 | tr -d ''; }; voice_block(){ adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys audio | sed -n '/- STREAM_VOICE_CALL:/,/Volume Group: AUDIO_STREAM_VOICE_CALL/p'; }; cleanup(){ python3 scripts/s22_call_control.py --serial "$SERIAL" hangup >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 0 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 8 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; }; trap cleanup EXIT; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 0; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 8 || true; PRE=$(voice_block); printf '%s
' "$PRE"; printf '%s
' "$PRE" | grep -q 'Muted: true'; printf '%s
' "$PRE" | grep -q 'streamVolume:0'; python3 scripts/s22_call_control.py --serial "$SERIAL" dial 510100100 >/dev/null; echo dial_requested=true; ACTIVE=0; for i in $(seq 1 40); do S=$(state); echo live_call_state=$S; if [ "$S" = "2" ]; then ACTIVE=1; break; fi; sleep 1; done; test "$ACTIVE" = "1"; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 0; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 8 || true; ACTIVE_AUDIO=$(voice_block); printf '%s
' "$ACTIVE_AUDIO"; printf '%s
' "$ACTIVE_AUDIO" | grep -q 'Muted: true'; printf '%s
' "$ACTIVE_AUDIO" | grep -q 'streamVolume:0'; printf '%s
' "$ACTIVE_AUDIO" | grep -q 'Devices: earpiece(1)'; echo silent_audio_guard_active=true; adb -s "$SERIAL" logcat -c; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell am force-stop pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge; START=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell am start -W -n pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge/.DiagnosticProbeActivity --ez run_shizuku_endurance_probe true 2>&1); printf '%s
' "$START"; printf '%s
' "$START" | grep -q 'Status: ok'; APP=''; HELPER=''; for i in $(seq 1 80); do APP=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pidof pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge | tr -d ''); HELPER=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell ps -A -o USER,PID,NAME | awk '$1=="shell" && $3 ~ /call_media$/ {print $2; exit}' | tr -d ''); if [ -n "$APP" ] && [ -n "$HELPER" ]; then break; fi; sleep 0.1; done; echo app_pid_before_kill=$APP; echo userservice_pid_before_app_death=$HELPER; test -n "$APP"; test -n "$HELPER"; MEDIA_ACTIVE=0; for i in $(seq 1 50); do SYSLOG=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" logcat -d -v brief); if printf '%s
' "$SYSLOG" | grep -E "u/pid:2000/$HELPER state:started.*USAGE_CALL_ASSISTANT|USAGE_CALL_ASSISTANT.*u/pid:2000/$HELPER state:started" >/dev/null; then MEDIA_ACTIVE=1; break; fi; sleep 0.1; done; echo call_assistant_active_before_app_death=$MEDIA_ACTIVE; test "$MEDIA_ACTIVE" = "1"; KILL_START=$(python3 -c 'import time; print(time.monotonic_ns())'); adb -s "$SERIAL" shell am force-stop pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge; APP_GONE=0; HELPER_GONE=0; STOP_SEEN=0; for i in $(seq 1 300); do if [ -z "$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pidof pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge | tr -d '')" ]; then APP_GONE=1; fi; if ! adb -s "$SERIAL" shell ps -A -o PID | grep -Eq "^[[:space:]]*$HELPER[[:space:]]*$"; then HELPER_GONE=1; fi; SYSLOG=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" logcat -d -v brief); if printf '%s
' "$SYSLOG" | grep -E "u/pid:2000/$HELPER state:stopped.*USAGE_CALL_ASSISTANT|USAGE_CALL_ASSISTANT.*u/pid:2000/$HELPER state:stopped" >/dev/null; then STOP_SEEN=1; fi; if [ "$APP_GONE" = "1" ] && [ "$HELPER_GONE" = "1" ] && [ "$STOP_SEEN" = "1" ]; then break; fi; sleep 0.01; done; KILL_END=$(python3 -c 'import time; print(time.monotonic_ns())'); STOP_MS=$(( (KILL_END-KILL_START)/1000000 )); echo app_process_gone=$APP_GONE; echo userservice_process_gone=$HELPER_GONE; echo call_assistant_stop_seen=$STOP_SEEN; echo app_death_to_media_cleanup_ms=$STOP_MS; test "$APP_GONE" = "1"; test "$HELPER_GONE" = "1"; test "$STOP_SEEN" = "1"; test "$STOP_MS" -le 3000; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell ps -A -o USER,PID,NAME | grep -E '^shell[[:space:]]+[0-9]+[[:space:]]+shizuku_server$'; POST_AUDIO=$(voice_block); printf '%s
' "$POST_AUDIO" | grep -q 'Muted: true'; printf '%s
' "$POST_AUDIO" | grep -q 'streamVolume:0'; printf '%s
' "$POST_AUDIO" | grep -q 'Devices: earpiece(1)'; echo silent_audio_guard_after_app_death=true; cleanup; trap - EXIT; test "$(state)" = "0"; echo milestone_d_app_death_silent_green=true
